description: NaSr₄(BN₂)₃ crystallizes in the cubic Im̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent N atoms to form NaN₆ octahedra that share faces with eight equivalent SrN₆ octahedra. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.45 Å. Sr is bonded to six equivalent N atoms to form distorted SrN₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SrN₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent SrN₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaN₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 23°. All Sr-N bond lengths are 2.74 Å. B is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent N atoms. Both B-N bond lengths are 1.35 Å. N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four equivalent Sr, and one B atom.
